title: Let the "for active application, show" dropdown menu be changed when the Window List widget is used on the desktop
line: On the desktop, the Window List button can now show the active app's icon, its name, or both.
explanation: When the Window List widget sits on the desktop small enough to show its button, the button only checked for a horizontal panel, so on the desktop (planar form factor) it always showed just the icon. The settings page disabled the "For active application, show" combo for the same reason and said it didn't apply on the desktop. The change treats every form factor except a vertical panel like the horizontal panel, so the button and the combo work on the desktop, and the hint now only appears on vertical panels.

commits.message:
applets/window-list: let the desktop button show icon, name or both

On the desktop the compact button always showed only the icon and the
"For active application, show" option was disabled there. Treat the
desktop like a horizontal panel so the button honours that option.

BUG: 528738

patches.diff:
From dce1116ade4ce7fdcc31cf5db228e0c5cfef3c1f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 13:40:58 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/window-list: let the desktop button show icon, name
 or both

On the desktop the compact button always showed only the icon and the
"For active application, show" option was disabled there. Treat the
desktop like a horizontal panel so the button honours that option.

BUG: 528738
---
 applets/window-list/ConfigGeneral.qml | 8 ++------
 applets/window-list/MenuButton.qml    | 6 +++---
 2 files changed, 5 insertions(+), 9 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/window-list/ConfigGeneral.qml b/applets/window-list/ConfigGeneral.qml
index 5d324eec09..dd00f33d7f 100644
--- a/applets/window-list/ConfigGeneral.qml
+++ b/applets/window-list/ConfigGeneral.qml
@@ -36,7 +36,7 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
 
             Kirigami.FormData.label: i18nc("@label:listbox", "For active application, show:")
 
-            enabled: Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Horizontal
+            enabled: Plasmoid.formFactor !== PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical
 
             model: [
                 i18nc("@item:inlistbox what to show for active application in horizontal panel", "Icon and name"),
@@ -86,11 +86,7 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
 
             visible: !displayModeComboBox.enabled
         
-            text: Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical ?
-                // On a vertical panel
-                i18nc("@info:usagetip display mode for active application", "Only icons can be shown when the Panel is vertical.") :
-                // On the desktop
-                i18nc("@info:usagetip display mode for active application", "Not applicable when the widget is on the Desktop.")
+            text: i18nc("@info:usagetip display mode for active application", "Only icons can be shown when the Panel is vertical.")
             textFormat: Text.PlainText
             wrapMode: Text.Wrap
             font: Kirigami.Theme.smallFont
diff --git a/applets/window-list/MenuButton.qml b/applets/window-list/MenuButton.qml
index 234002bf53..fc1a1ab1b2 100644
--- a/applets/window-list/MenuButton.qml
+++ b/applets/window-list/MenuButton.qml
@@ -54,7 +54,7 @@ AbstractButton {
     contentItem: RowLayout {
         Kirigami.Icon {
             id: iconItem
-            visible: (Plasmoid.formFactor !== PlasmaCore.Types.Horizontal
+            visible: (Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical
               || Plasmoid.configuration.showIcon) && source !== "" && iconItem.valid
 
             implicitWidth: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.sizeForLabels
@@ -64,7 +64,7 @@ AbstractButton {
         }
         // Fall back to a generic icon if the application doesn't provide a valid one
         Kirigami.Icon {
-            visible: (Plasmoid.formFactor !== PlasmaCore.Types.Horizontal
+            visible: (Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical
               || Plasmoid.configuration.showIcon) && !iconItem.valid
 
             source: "preferences-system-windows"
@@ -76,7 +76,7 @@ AbstractButton {
         }
         PC3.Label {
             id: label
-            visible: Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Horizontal && Plasmoid.configuration.showText
+            visible: Plasmoid.formFactor !== PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical && Plasmoid.configuration.showText
 
             text: controlRoot.text
             color: controlRoot.down || controlRoot.hovered ? Kirigami.Theme.highlightedTextColor : Kirigami.Theme.textColor
--
